verdict.rationale: Supabase's first-party docs say you can deploy Supabase on your own infrastructure with Docker Compose, and recommend Docker as the fastest route. The CLI also launches a full local Supabase stack, and a runtime probe confirmed it runs without an account or login. Missing for 10: detail on feature parity between self-hosted and the hosted platform, any hands-on or independent confirmation of a self-hosted deployment, and evidence of open-source licensing of the core components.
